summary: Created a 4-phase implementation plan for giving reconcile-task-status.sh a defined, safe recovery behavior when .orchestrator-handoff.json carries a status outside the normative vocabulary. Design: three-way classification in handoff_permits_promotion() -- exact match permits, on-enum terminal mismatch refuses unchanged, and any value carrying no terminal claim permits with a mandatory loud diagnostic. Phases cover the helper rewrite with recorded rationale, the partial-branch call-site consolidation, a fixture-driven regression suite, and a full gate plus rule-compliance sweep.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase implementation plan: helper rewrite with recorded rationale, partial-branch consolidation, 11-case regression suite, final gate and rule sweep
